title: Ode to Joy
short: Ludwig van Beethoven · C 4/4 · play it with every note lit.

blocks.html: Beethoven wrote this tune for the last movement of his Ninth Symphony. It mostly moves by step and stays in C position. In bars 4, 8 and 16, hold the dotted quarter note a little longer and play the short note right after it. In bar 12 your thumb drops down to the G below middle C, then comes back.

blocks.name: music-player
blocks.cap: Play it: the score scrolls, the keys or strings light up as each note sounds.

blocks.html: The piece: Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125 (1824), last movement: the main theme

sources.name: Melody checked note by note against the Mutopia Project’s “Ode to Joy” hymn setting (SATB, public domain), moved from G down to C. The left hand is our own and follows that setting’s chords.
